verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing supports configurable 'transaction rules' to automatically approve or decline authorizations and relayed authorization webhooks allowing custom logic at auth time, which could implement MCC or merchant restrictions, but the evidence never explicitly describes MCC allow/blocklists or single-merchant locking as a documented feature. missing for 10: explicit documentation of MCC-based allow/block rules, single-merchant lock configuration, and confirmation these are evaluated at authorization time.
